primary_question: Does Python ON improve quantitative petroleum-engineering outcomes over the same Agent v3 with Python OFF?
numeric_authority: frozen independent ground truth and deterministic scorer; semantic reviewer never changes numeric values
numeric_match: final answer value within frozen absolute tolerance with target unit in local context; CALC result value within tolerance; manual QA may correct documented false matches without editing raw scores
unit_match: explicit target unit or frozen equivalent in the same local answer context; no inferred units
criterion_pass: all numeric targets assigned to a criterion pass; qualitative source/engineering meaning is assessed by one blinded semantic reviewer
goal_success: all fixed criteria pass, no material engineering contradiction, and no hallucination
external_coverage: fraction of fixed criteria passing external scoring; product goal_coverage is telemetry only
task_funnel: aggregate every iteration; never replace an earlier selected/validated step with a later not-selected iteration

semantic_reviewer.scope: qualitative engineering meaning and source support only

manual_qa: 24/24 final answers; preserve raw reviewer and deterministic output; corrections only in separate strict_adjudicated_v1_1 file
